brief.zh: 「接着攒」为 1 的每一拍，把「位」接到已经攒下的数的末尾（先来的位在高位），交出攒到的数；为 0 的那一拍交出 0，从头再攒。
brief.en: On every tick Go on is 1, put Bit at the end of the number gathered so far (the first bit highest) and give out the number; on a tick it is 0, give out 0 and start over.

t.zh: 总线上的数是一位一位到的：说话的控制器先说最高位。探针要把它们攒回一个数。
t.en: Numbers come over the bus a bit at a time, the highest bit first. The probe has to gather them back into a number.

t.zh: 攒下的数后面多接一位，它在二进制里整体左移了一格，再加上新来的那一位。
t.en: Putting one more bit after the number gathered so far shifts it one place left in binary, then adds the new bit.

desc.zh: 「接着攒」为 1 时，把「位」接到攒下的数末尾，交出新的数；为 0 时交出 0 并清空。每一块有自己的寄存卡。
desc.en: When Go on is 1, puts Bit at the end of the number gathered and gives the new number; when it is 0, gives 0 and empties. Each one has registers of its own.

after.zh: 一个数加上自己，就是左移一格；再加上新的一位，就接上了。
after.en: A number added to itself is shifted one place left; add the new bit and it is on the end.
